description: This file defines the class ReadSubjectExtractor which implements the PubSubTopicExtractor interface. It extracts read-subjects as topics from messages, specifically by retrieving headers and permission subjects.

classes.name: ReadSubjectExtractor
classes.description: A final class providing a static factory method to create instances that extract read subjects as topics from messages of type T.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a ReadSubjectExtractor.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Extracts a collection of topic strings (IDs of granted subjects) from the message's headers.
